rubric_title: Medical Record Narrative - Clinical Documentation Integrity Evaluation Rubric

overall.decision_note: Material gaps. Return to the author for amendment; do not finalise coding.

hard_rules_triggered.reason: No principal diagnosis can be assigned from the narrative as written. Specificity elsewhere in the record does not substitute for a codable principal diagnosis.

dimension_results.name: Authentication and Legal Integrity
dimension_results.matched_level_text: Every entry authenticated with author name, credentials, date and time. Verbal and telephone orders co-signed within policy. Amendments, corrections and late entries explicitly labelled, with the original content preserved and a reason stated. No unattributed sections.
dimension_results.matched_snippet: Electronically signed by Jane Smith, MD,...

dimension_results.name: Chief Complaint and History of Present Illness
dimension_results.matched_level_text: Chief complaint stated in the patient's own terms. HPI develops the story with four or more of the eight elements (location, quality, severity, duration, timing, context, modifying factors, associated signs and symptoms), a clear chronology, and pertinent positives and negatives. Where the patient is not the historian, the source is identified.

dimension_results.name: Histories, Medications, Allergies and Social Determinants
dimension_results.matched_level_text: Past medical, surgical, family and social histories documented and relevant to the presentation. Home medications reconciled with dose, route and frequency. Allergies recorded with the specific reaction. Social determinants relevant to care - housing, food security, transport, caregiver support, substance use - captured in the narrative and carried to codable Z-codes.

dimension_results.name: Continuity, Timeliness and Transition of Care
dimension_results.matched_level_text: Entries authored contemporaneously with the care described, and the record completed within the regulatory window. The discharge summary carries every required element - reason for hospitalisation, significant findings, procedures and treatment provided, condition at discharge, reconciled discharge medications, follow-up arrangements naming provider and interval, and results still pending at discharge. Patient instructions documented in comprehensible terms.
